$comment: A 1.5-second Ice Mirror break built from the saved idle scene. Exactly three hero crystals keep their vertical bubble motion as three broad screen panels release.
name: Ice Shield - Mirror Break
description: A compact hit releases three broad textured mirror facets and three small chips while the three idle crystals keep bobbing.
author: vfx-pipeline

layers.note: Exactly three distinct prepared hero crystals bob on their existing vertical lanes; five minor shards remain secondary.
Eight small snowflake cards keep the idle's quiet companion motion.
The same cold transparent, ground-pointing equal-sided hex fades as its three broad panels release.
One faint cyan outline follows the six-sided screen and clears with the break.
Three broad textured mirror panels separate and tilt in depth; three small chips add detail without a web of shards.
